parent_objective: audit artifact-only scenario/support redesign consolidation result and choose the next task-quality route
blocked_by: M2343 result must be audited before choosing geometry/timing or hidden-dynamics rebalance
controller comparison remains blocked until task-quality route is selected
supersedes: direct hidden-dynamics range rebalance after M2343

public_gates: M2344 must audit M2343 summary and 13/13 route split
M2344 must preserve non-ranking and artifact-only claim boundary
M2344 must choose a bounded follow-up route or branch synthesis
M2344 must not run reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank support policies or controller families
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim residual support solved
do not claim controller comparison readiness

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits 26-row redesign consolidation and selects the next task-quality branch
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2343 artifacts are incomplete
stop if audit claims redesign has been executed
stop if audit routes directly to controller comparison
stop if audit ignores the 13/13 geometry-vs-hidden split
fallback_plan: route to implementation repair if artifacts are incomplete
route to branch synthesis if the 13/13 split makes a single next branch ambiguous
route to bounded geometry/timing rebalance design if geometry/timing is selected
route to hidden-dynamics range rebalance design if hidden range is selected

allowed_updates: M2344 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2343 artifacts are accepted or rejected
13/13 route split is interpreted without claiming a fix
a bounded non-ranking follow-up route or synthesis is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2344 audits task-quality consolidation and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2344; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: M2343 redesign consolidation must be interpreted as task-quality evidence, not driver or self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns consolidated redesign output into a next-route decision
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether to synthesize, rebalance geometry/timing, or rebalance hidden dynamics before current-sim controller comparison
must_synthesize_if: M2344 cannot select a next task-quality route
the redesign consolidation branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: M2343 provides enough redesign consolidation evidence to choose the next bounded task-quality route without execution or ranking.
success_criteria: a follow-up non-ranking route or synthesis is selected
failure_criteria: M2344 starts training reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2344 ranks support policies or selects a winner
M2344 makes finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 self-ID claims
M2344 routes directly to controller comparison

commands.name: audit

decision_rule: M2344 passes if it audits M2343 and selects a bounded non-ranking follow-up route or synthesis.
